headline: Philippine hog stock falls to three-decade low
summary: The Philippines' national swine inventory declined 1.9% to 8.94 million heads as of Sept. 30, its lowest level since 1995, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority. Structural headwinds are cited for domestic hog producers.
why: Hog inventories drive domestic pork supply and prices, which feed into food inflation and the earnings of livestock and feed producers.
